s: Dine birkat hattora ubo y' seipim: birkat hattora tzarik lizzaher bah meod, shello chorba haaretz ella mippene shello bereku battora techilla, lepi shello hayeta chashuba beenehem kol kak lebarek aleha, lekak hayu mezalzelim bebirkatah, laken lo hegenna alehem toratam ap al pi sheasequ bah harbeh. Ulekak yireh kol adam shettihyeh keli chemdato shel haqqadosh baruk hu shehaya mishtaashea bah bekol yom, chashuba beenayv lebarek aleha besimcha yoter meal kol hanaot shebbaolam, shezzeh moreh sheoseq bah lishmah. Veyizkeh leshalshelet hannimshak laoseq bah lishmah, shehu "lo yamushu mippika umippi zaraka vego'", shetteaseh sheelato ubaqqashato shemmebaqqesh bebirkatah "venihyeh anachnu vetzeetzaenu". Veyesh medaqdeqim lehosip "vetzeetzae tzeetzaenu", ki kol shehu ubeno uben beno talmid chakam — shub en tora poseqet mizzaro leolam. Veen tzarik lekak, ki biklal "tzeetzaenu" hem gam ken bene banim:

Tzarik lebarek ben lemiqra lebad, ben lemishna lebaddah, ben letalmud lebaddo, ben lemidrash lebaddo, shehakkol tora hi venittena lemosheh missinay. Vehamharher bedibre tora — en tzarik lebarek. Vehu haddin sheyakol lipsoq din belo netinat taam lidbarayv, shezzehu gam ken eno ella hirhur, vehirhur lav kedibbur hu, kemo she[yi]tebbaer besiman s"b:

Yesh mi sheomer shehakkoteb bedibre tora ap al pi sheeno qore — tzarik lebarek. Vehu shekkoteb separim leatzmo derek limmudo umebin mah shehu koteb, abal soper hammatiq veeno mebaqqesh lehabin — en tzarik lebarek. Veken im koteb ezeh pasuq beiggeret hareshut lidbar tzachut — eno tzarik lebarek, kevan sheeno mitkavven lelimmud. Uleinyan maaseh en lismok al debarayv lebarek al ketiba lebaddah beshum inyan, shehare eno raq meharher bedibre tora, ella rauy lekol koteb bedibre tora sheyyotzi mippiv qetzat tebot lehinnatzel mibberaka lebattala, im eno omer pesuqe birkat kohanim o shear dabar min hattora achar habberaka kemo shennohagin:

Birkat hattora: "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al dibre tora", venussach medinot ellu "laasoq bedibre tora", "vehaareb na veku'" va"asher bachar banu ku'". Veger yakol lebarek gam ken "asher bachar banu":

Yesh omerim shetztzarik lomar "haareb" bevay"v, shebberaka achat hi im "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu ku'", shehu matbea arok potachat be"baruk" vechotemet be"baruk atta Hashem hamlammed ku'", sheim haya matbea qatzar "vehaareb" hi beraka bipne atzmah — haya lah liptoach be"baruk". Veap al pi shehi beraka hassemuka lachabertah — en zeh moil kelum bemaqom shehabberaka shellepaneha hi matbea qatzar, shehare birkat hahabdala potachat be"baruk" ap al pi shehi semuka lebirkat hanner vehabbesamim hoil vehen qetzarot. Veyesh omerim she"haareb" hi beraka bipne atzmah, veenah doma lebirkat hahabdala, lepi shebbirkat habdala enah semuka leolam lebirkat hanner vehabbesamim, sheim rotzeh mebarek al hanner ubesamim bipne atzmam veachar kak mabdil al hakkos belo ner ubesamim. Umittaam zeh potachat birkat "asher bachar banu" be"baruk", lepi shebbiqriat hattora betztzibbur mebarek otah bipne atzmah. Veken nahagu lomar "haareb" belo va"v. Abal yoter tob lomar beva"v, lepi sheap im hi beraka bipne atzmah veomerah betosepet va"v — en bekak kelum. Abal im hi beraka achat veomerah belo va"v — hare zeh mapsiq beemtza beraka. Veken al pi hassod hi beraka bipne atzmah, veyesh laanot amen benetayim, veap al pi ken yesh lomar "vehaareb" beva"v:

Birkat "ahaba rabba" o "ahabat olam", hoil veyesh bah meen birkat hattora "veten belibbenu lilmod ulelammed ku'" — hare zo poteret millebarek birkat hattora im lamad achar qeriat shema utepilla miyyad beli hepseq, sheaz niret beraka leshem eseq hattora kemo liqriat shema, veaz lo yitztarek lebarek kol oto hayyom apillu hipsiq veamad vechazar lelimmudo al derek sheyyitbaer bebirkat hattora. Abal im eno lomed miyyad achar hattepilla — tzarik lebarek al mah sheyyilmod. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik lebarek, ella im ken lo qara qeriat shema miyyad achar "ahaba rabba" o "ahabat olam", abal im qara miyyad achareha — dayyah bekak, upoteret limmud shel kol hayyom al derek sheyyitbaer bebirkat hattora. Veyesh lachosh ledibre shenehem, velizzaher lebarek birkat hattora qodem hattepilla, velo lismok al "ahaba rabba" o "ahabat olam" im lo yilmod miyyad achar hattepilla kassebara harishona, vegam shello lebarek birkat hattora al mah sheyyilmod achar kak kassebara haacharona:

Ukeshemmebarek birkat hattora — yesh omerim sheen tzarik lilmod miyyad achareha, ella ap al pi shehipsiq ben beraka lelimmudo — dino keillu hipsiq beemtza limmudo veal derek sheyyitbaer, veenah doma lebirkat hammitzvot ulebirkat hannehenin sheim hipsiq ben beraka lehatchalat asiyya shealeha mebarek tzarik lachazor ulebarek, lepi shekkevan sheim ratza shello laasotah ad leachar shaa hareshut beyado, ulepikak keshemmapsiq ben beraka laasiyya nireh sheen otah beraka chozeret al otah asiyya, abal talmud tora shechayyab laasoq bah tamid keshemmapsiq ben beraka lallimmud — lo chashib hepseq, meachar shebbeoto zeman shemmapsiq mechuyyab hu lilmod. Veyesh choleqim al zeh. Venakon lachosh ledibrehem velizzaher shello lehapsiq benehem kelal, kemo bishar mitzvot. Veken nahagu lomar birkat kohanim samuk lebirkat hattora. Vekevan sheomerin otah leshem limmud (velo mishshum zeker linsiat kappayim) — omerin otah apillu qodem or habboqer, ap al pi sheen nesiat kappayim ballayla. Uledibre hakkol, im hitchil lilmod achar birkat hattora vehipsiq millilmod venitasseq baasaqayv vechazar lelimmudo — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek im hu adam sheragil lilmod tamid, veap kesheyyotze lehitasseq beparnasato memaher laasot tzerakayv bekol mah deepshar kede lachazor velilmod, sheeseq zeh eno chashub hepseq leinyan beraka, kevan shebbeshaa shehu mitasseq bo dato al limmudo. Vehu haddin lammerchatz ulebet hakkisse sheenan chashubin hepseq, lepi sheap beodo bammerchatz ubet hakkisse — eno massiach dato millilmod achar kak. Veken im hishkib atzmo lishon veeno yakol lishon — en zeh hepseq, lepi shebbeodo neor dato al limmudo. Veken im yashan al atztzile yadayv shenat aray — enah chashuba hepseq. Abal yashan shenat qeba al mittato — chashuba hepseq. Veken mi sheen darko lilmod tamid uberak velamad shiuro veyatza laasaqayv vehissiach dato millilmod od beoto hayyom veachar kak nimlak lachazor velilmod — tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Veyesh omerim shebbirkat hattora hi kebirkot hashshachar shello tiqqenu otan ella paam achat bayyom, ulepikak apillu yashan shenat qeba al mittato o sheyyatza laasaqayv vehissiach dato — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Veken nahagu. Ukeshellomed ballayla kol zeman shello yashan — en tzarik lebarek ledibre hakkol, shehallayla holek achar hayyom. Ukesheyyashan shenat qeba vehishkim qodem alot hashshachar — tzarik lebarek ledibre hakkol, sheap lisbara acharona shehi kebirkot hashshachar — hare gam birkot hashshachar zemannan hu gam ken qodem or hayyom, miyyad shenneor mishshenato. Veim haya neor kol hallayla — lassebara harishona en tzarik lebarek kesheyyeor hayyom kol zeman shello hissiach dato millilmod, velassebara haacharona — tzarik lebarek kesheyyeor hayyom, kemo shear birkot hashshachar shennohagin lebarek ap al pi shello nitchayyeb bahen. Veharotzeh latzet yede sapeq — yishma birkat hattora meacher veyitkavven latzet yede chobato im epshar, veim lav — yebarek beatzmo:

Hammashkim qodem or hayyom lilmod — mebarek birkat hattora. Veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek bebet hakkeneset apillu im hu sheliach tzibbur veyored lipne hatteba, kemo shennitbaer besiman m"v vesiman v':

Hammashkim qodem or hayyom — yakol lebarek kol seder habberakot, chutz mibbirkat "hannoten lassekvi bina" u"parashat hattamid", ayyen siman a' sheyyamtin milleomrah ad sheyyeor hayyom. Veim shama qol tarnegol — yakol lebarek "hannoten lassekvi bina" miyyad achar chatzot layla. Ulekattechilla yittol yadayv qodem sheyyebarek lilmod. Veim en lo mayim — yakol lebarek velilmod belo netila, raq sheyyenaqqeh yadayv bitzror o beapar o beqora, kemo shennitbaer besiman d':

Nashim mebarekot birkot hattora, shehare chayyabot lilmod mitzvot shellahen, leda heak laasotan veheak lizzaher mikkol lo taaseh shehen muzharot bahen kaanashim, vehen chayyabot bitpilla kemo anashim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"v (veod shebbirkat hattora mebarekin qodem "parashat hattamid" ubiqriat "parashat hattamid" hen shavot laanashim, shehare tepilla bimqom tamid tiqqenuha):
